lens: A heavy proxy-filing day led by gaming: Caesars filed its $31.00/share Fertitta take-private proxy (PJT, Morgan Stanley, Jefferies), Payoneer filed its $7.40 Nuvei merger proxy (Goldman), DoubleVerify agreed a $13.60 take-private (PJT), Skyworks priced $2.0B of Qorvo-deal notes (Goldman, BofA, JPMorgan, Wells Fargo), and NCM agreed to buy Captivate for $275M (BofA) — a broad covered-bank slate even as advisory stocks kept sliding.

stories.headline: Caesars files its $31.00/share take-private proxy by Fertitta Entertainment; PJT Partners advises Caesars, Morgan Stanley advises Fertitta
stories.why_it_matters: Caesars Entertainment (Nasdaq: CZR) filed a preliminary merger proxy (PREM14A) for its acquisition by Fertitta Entertainment (Tilman Fertitta) at $31.00/share in cash, via Fertitta Gaming Holdco/Empire Merger Sub. The filing names PJT Partners as Caesars' exclusive financial adviser and fairness-opinion provider (sell-side), Morgan Stanley as adviser to Fertitta (buy-side, which provided a financing 'highly confident' letter), and Jefferies as adviser to the Icahn Group (a Caesars shareholder). A large sponsor-style gaming take-private runs committed-financing, gaming-regulatory and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage PJT Partners (Caesars) and Morgan Stanley (Fertitta) — a $31.00/share gaming take-private runs committed-financing, multi-state gaming-license and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Caesars board approves $31.00/share merger with Fertitta Entertainment

stories.headline: Payoneer files its merger proxy for the $7.40/share Nuvei acquisition; Goldman advises Nuvei
stories.why_it_matters: Payoneer Global (Nasdaq: PAYO) filed a definitive merger proxy (DEFM14A) for its acquisition by Nuvei (Neon Maple Parent) at $7.40/share in cash, advancing the June 12 agreement to a shareholder vote. The filing names Goldman Sachs as financial adviser to Nuvei (buy-side); Qatalyst Partners advised Payoneer (sell-side). A cross-border fintech/payments take-private runs antitrust, money-transmitter-licensing and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Goldman (Nuvei) on the Payoneer acquisition — a cross-border payments take-private runs multi-jurisdiction licensing and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

stories.headline: DoubleVerify to be taken private by Neptune BidCo at $13.60/share; PJT Partners advises DoubleVerify
stories.why_it_matters: DoubleVerify Holdings (NYSE: DV) entered a definitive agreement (dated Aug 6, filed Aug 10) to be acquired by Neptune BidCo US Inc. (a private-equity vehicle, via Wallace Merger Sub) at $13.60/share in cash, backed by an equity commitment letter and limited guarantee. The merger agreement names PJT Partners as DoubleVerify's financial adviser (sell-side). A sponsor take-private of an ad-verification/adtech platform runs financing, antitrust and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage PJT Partners (DoubleVerify) — a sponsor take-private of an adtech platform runs committed-financing, antitrust and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: DoubleVerify agrees to $13.60/share take-private by Neptune BidCo

stories.headline: National CineMedia to acquire Captivate for $275M; BofA Securities and Solomon Partners advise
stories.why_it_matters: National CineMedia (Nasdaq: NCMI) entered a definitive agreement (Aug 10) to acquire Captivate Holdings — a North American digital elevator/lobby advertising network of 26,000+ screens — from Generation Partners for a $275M enterprise value (~10x pro forma EBITDA), funded entirely with new committed term debt. The release names BofA Securities and Solomon Partners as financial advisers to the respective parties. NCM paused its dividend on the expected close-leverage. A debt-funded adtech/out-of-home acquisition runs financing and integration workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage BofA Securities on the NCM/Captivate deal — a debt-funded out-of-home advertising acquisition runs committed-term-debt and integration diligence a secure room organizes.

deal_clock.event: NCM agrees to acquire Captivate for $275M EV

stories.headline: Skyworks prices $2.0B of senior notes to fund its Qorvo combination; Goldman, BofA, JPMorgan and Wells Fargo lead
stories.why_it_matters: Skyworks Solutions filed the underwriting agreement (dated Aug 4, filed Aug 10) for a $2.0B three-part senior-notes offering — $800M 5.000% due 2028, $600M 5.750% due 2032, $600M 6.250% due 2036 — with a special mandatory redemption tied to its pending Qorvo combination. Goldman Sachs, BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan and Wells Fargo Securities are named as representatives of the underwriters. Acquisition-financing debt raises run disclosure and syndicate-diligence workstreams alongside the M&A track.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Goldman/BofA/JPMorgan/Wells Fargo on the Skyworks notes — acquisition-financing raises run alongside the Qorvo M&A diligence a secure room keeps organized across both workstreams.
stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Skyworks Solutions underwriting agreement (EX-1.1)

A sponsor take-private of a public marina operator runs committed-financing, antitrust and shareholder-vote workstreams as it heads toward a vote.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Wells Fargo (MarineMax) and Evercore (Safe Harbor) — a ~$1.5B sponsor take-private runs committed-financing, antitrust and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: MarineMax agrees to $53.00/share sale to Safe Harbor (~$1.5B)

deal_clock.event: Ryman agrees to acquire Grande Lakes Orlando ($1.38B)

stories.headline: Archer's acquisition of Boeing's Wisk, Insitu and SkyGrid advances; JPMorgan advises Boeing, Moelis advises Archer

J.P. Morgan advises Boeing (sell-side) and Moelis advises Archer (buy-side). A multi-unit aerospace/defense carve-out runs separation, regulatory (defense/ITAR) and equity-consideration workstreams.

A biopharma cash-plus-CVR merger runs milestone-structuring, disclosure and shareholder-vote workstreams.

stories.headline: Advisory stocks extend their slide even as fresh mandates pile up — EVR -5.3%, JEF -2.3%, GS -1.9%
stories.why_it_matters: Equities were mixed midday Aug 12 (S&P +0.30%, Nasdaq +0.79%, Dow -0.94%), with the VIX easing to ~14.8 and the 10Y around ~4.67%. The advisory complex kept selling off — Evercore (-5.3%), Jefferies (-2.3%) and Goldman (-1.9%) — a second straight session of weakness against a genuinely heavy mandate slate (Caesars take-private proxy, Payoneer/Nuvei, DoubleVerify take-private, NCM/Captivate). The divergence between advisory-stock softness and robust filing flow underscores that pipeline strength shows up in mandates before the tape.
stories.suggested_action: Lean on the deal flow, not the stock tape — a second soft session for advisory shares alongside a steady stream of proxy filings is a cue to keep the conversation on live-process execution and room readiness.

market_snapshot.macro_note: Mixed midday tape Aug 12 with a persistent advisory-stock pullback: the S&P 500 rose +0.30% (~7,747) and the Nasdaq +0.79% (~26,571) while the Dow lagged -0.94% (~53,840); the VIX eased to ~14.8 and the 10Y held near ~4.67%. The advisory complex kept selling — EVR -5.3%, JEF -2.3%, GS -1.9% (JPM bucked it, +1.5%) — a second straight session of weakness against a steady stream of proxy filings (Caesars, Payoneer/Nuvei, DoubleVerify, NCM/Captivate). Index and bank-stock values are live Aug 12 midday levels.

talking_point.quote: The advisory tape stayed soft again Tuesday into Wednesday — Evercore, Jefferies and Goldman all down — but the filings told the opposite story: Caesars' $31 Fertitta take-private proxy, Payoneer's $7.40 Nuvei proxy, DoubleVerify's $13.60 take-private, and NCM's $275M Captivate buy, all with banks we cover. Pipeline strength shows up in proxy filings before it shows up in the stock. Which of your live processes has the nearest diligence milestone this week?
talking_point.use_with: Consumer/gaming, fintech/FIG, TMT/adtech and healthcare coverage teams (esp. PJT Partners, Morgan Stanley, Goldman, BofA, JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Evercore, Lazard)
